decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing the combo potential of Spark Double and Clever Impersonator to copy powerful creatures like Spinewoods Armadillo and Trumpeting Carnosaur, creating a strong board presence. Leyline Binding helps control the opponent's board while Quintorius Kand gives extra value to tokens. The inclusion of Keruga, the Macrosage as a companion adds consistency to the deck. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the color requirements of the deck. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of strong creatures and clever interactions.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill up your graveyard with spells and then bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard to the battlefield. The deck includes a lot of cheap spells and card draw to help achieve this goal, while also including some control elements like Spell Pierce to protect your threats. The deck aims to be aggressive and fast-paced, using the synergy between cheap spells and the recurring threat of Arclight Phoenix to overwhelm your opponent. It also includes some land manipulation with Picklock Prankster and Otawara, Soaring City to help ensure consistent mana sources.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent using aggressive creatures and powerful abilities. By utilizing cards like Tree of Perdition, Voldaren Epicure, and Bloodtithe Harvester, along with support from Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, this Rakdos Aggro deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. With a mix of creatures, spells, and lands that complement each other, the deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory through swift and efficient aggression.

The deck focuses on controlling the game and maintaining board advantage by utilizing a mix of counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up its own win conditions through efficient control spells and powerful threats. The deck includes powerful planeswalkers like Narset, Parter of Veils, as well as versatile removal like Portable Hole and Supreme Verdict. The mana base is built to support the deck's game plan by providing a mix of colored sources and utility lands to ensure consistency and resilience against various strategies.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo revolving around Amalia Benavides Aguirre and various creatures that provide mana acceleration and life gain. The goal is to quickly ramp up mana, gain life, and dig for key combo pieces using cards like Collected Company and Chord of Calling. The deck also includes protection with cards like Skyclave Apparition and Selfless Savior. The key strategy is to create a board state that allows for explosive plays and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creatures and abilities.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard to the battlefield. It utilizes cheap spells like Consider, Opt, and Lightning Axe to trigger the Phoenix's ability and deal damage to the opponent. Treasure Cruise helps refuel the hand with card draw, while cards like Riverglide Pathway and Hall of Storm Giants provide additional threats. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion, offering additional mana fixing and ramp. Overall, the deck aims to be fast and aggressive, overwhelming the opponent with a constant stream of threats.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast-paced aggression, utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt opponents while playing powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Bonecrusher Giant. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and game-ending threats like Archfiend of the Dross and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse ensures that the deck can close out games quickly. With a mix of hand disruption, removal spells, and powerful creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents before they have a chance to stabilize.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on using low-cost creatures and removal spells to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. By combining aggressive creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Vein Ripper with efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, the deck aims to maintain control of the board while pressuring the opponent. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Duress allows the player to disrupt their opponent's strategy, while powerful finishers like Archfiend of the Dross and Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord provide additional threats to close out the game.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature strategies paired with powerful removal and hand disruption spells. It aims to quickly build a threatening board presence with cards like Bloodtithe Harvester and Vein Ripper, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, along with Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord, allows for additional value and resilience in longer games. The deck's mana base is carefully constructed to support its aggressive game plan while ensuring consistent color access.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to disrupt the opponent's strategy and outvalue them in the long run. The deck also includes a companion, Kaheera, the Orphanguard, which provides additional utility and synergy with the rest of the cards. With a mix of control elements and a solid mana base, this UW Control deck aims to outmaneuver and outlast the opponent to secure victory in a Pioneer 1 vs 1 match.

This deck focuses on utilizing the combination of creatures like Amalia Benavides Aguirre, Prosperous Innkeeper, and Wildgrowth Walker to gain life and generate mana. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces, with Aetherflux Reservoir as the win condition, to gain a large amount of life and deal lethal damage to the opponent. Key cards like Chord of Calling and Collected Company help to search for and put together the necessary pieces for the combo. The deck also includes disruption elements like Takenuma, Abandoned Mire and Skyclave Apparition to interact with the opponent's strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to consistently bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard and use cheap spells to trigger its ability. The deck includes numerous card draw and selection spells to help find the Phoenix and fill the graveyard. Additional aggressive creatures and removal spells are included to support the strategy. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of board presence and quick damage output. The mana base is optimized to support the casting of both the Phoenix and the various spells in the deck.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive red creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also includes burn spells like Skewer the Critics and Wizard's Lightning to remove threats and continue pressuring the opponent. The deck utilizes cards like Ramunap Ruins and Den of the Bugbear for additional damage and mana efficiency. With a low mana curve and a focus on dealing damage quickly, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and win the game before they can stabilize.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent by playing cheap and efficient creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to apply continuous pressure on the opponent and finish them off before they have a chance to stabilize. By utilizing creatures with prowess and powerful burn spells, the deck looks to create a fast-paced aggressive strategy that overwhelms the opponent. Additionally, with the companion Jegantha, the deck gains an additional source of mana acceleration and a potential finisher in the late game.

This aggressive Rakdos deck focuses on using efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to clear the opponent's board while deploying powerful creatures like Vein Ripper and Bloodtithe Harvester to apply pressure. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck utilizes tribal synergies with vampires like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet to further enhance its aggressive strategy. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and enable the powerful plays it aims to make.

The deck focuses on using low-cost creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and deal damage efficiently. It also utilizes cards that provide card advantage and synergy with the aggro strategy, such as Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Vein Ripper. The mana base is optimized for consistent early game plays, and the deck includes a mix of disruption and removal to control the board and protect its threats. Overall, the deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent and win the game through quick and aggressive tactics.
